cohort: Pregnant women above 18 years old who attended antenatal care, performed the quadruple test, and delivered at Phrapokklao Hospital between July 2020 and March 2022, excluding those with fetal chromosome anomalies or maternal diabetes mellitus.
finding: The study found that gestational hypertension correlated with a high-risk quadruple test, age, multiparity, and BMI, with beta-hCG (mean 2.86 MoM) specifically identified as assisting in predicting gestational hypertension and preeclampsia.
